items.headline: Freeze Warning issued November 14 at 7:02AM EST until November 15 at 9:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 30 expected.

* WHERE...Beaufort, Coastal Onslow, Inland Onslow, Jones, Northern
Craven, Southern Craven, Washington, and West Carteret Counties.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
items.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 14 at 6:17AM EST until November 14 at 12:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...Until noon EST today.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
